// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / control / if switch and match
if (let Some(value) = maybe) {
// <- keyword.control.conditional.ds
    value
} else {
    0
}

switch (kind) {
// <- keyword.control.conditional.ds
    case "a":
        break;
    default:
        break;
}

match (result) {
// <- keyword.control.conditional.ds
    Ok(value) if (value > 0) => value
    Err(error) => throw error
}

// expressions / control / loops breaks and continues
const loopValue = loop {
//                ^^^^ keyword.control.loop.ds
    break 1;
};

const labeledValue = outer: loop {
    break outer: 1;
//  ^^^^^ keyword.control.flow.ds
};

for (const item of items) {
// <- keyword.control.loop.ds
    continue;
}

while (ready()) {
// <- keyword.control.loop.ds
    break;
}

// expressions / control / try catch and throw
try {
// <- keyword.control.exception.ds
    read()?
} catch match (failure) {
    IOError(error) => recover(error)
} finally {
    cleanup();
}

throw error;
// <- keyword.control.exception.ds
